entities.name: José da Costa Nunes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dom José da Costa Nunes was a Portuguese cardinal of the Roman Catholic Church who served as Bishop of Macau from 1920 to 1940 and Patriarch of the East Indies from 1940 to 1953. He was made a cardinal in 1962.
